answer: Because the relic derivation is checked against the whisper nonce, the echo audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. An answer must include the first 23 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 20 aliases produces 20 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
